title: urtica dioica var. carpatica
intro: Urtica dioica var. carpatica, commonly known as Alpine Nettle, is a variety of the Urtica dioica plant, a perennial herbaceous plant native to Europe. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Nettle include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a useful treatment for conditions such as arthritis, skin irritations, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Urtica dioica var. carpatica include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
